# Scenario A: funded round for task 3, then the stop note

**Held state before this round**
- Task 3 has hit `failed[3] == 2`, and `escalated[3]` is set. The escalated round failed with an attributed `FIX_FIRST`, so it is spent.
- The grant reads `**Amend-grant:** fund 1 fix rounds`, so N = 1. The funding ledger for task 3 starts at 0 spent.
- The round cap is 4 + 1 = 5 re-reviews. The escalated re-review was number 4, so the funded re-review is number 5, still within the cap.
- `implModel` is `<configured-impl-model>`, already resolved from `escalationLoop`.
- The prior review tree (the tree-before value) was recorded when re-review 4 was dispatched.
- The escalated round's `RP_TREE` was removed after its delta was applied. The integrated tree has changed since then, so a new repair-base snapshot is needed.

**1. Take a new repair-base snapshot**

Print first:
```text
funded round 1 of 1 for task 3
```
Then run the snapshot recipe:
```bash
RP_ROOT='/workspace/project'
RP_BASE='<WAVE_BASE_SHA>'
SCRATCH="$(git -C "$RP_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir)/gauntlet/tmp" || exit 1
mkdir -p "$SCRATCH" || exit 1
RP_DIR=$(mktemp -d "$SCRATCH/repair.XXXXXX") || exit 1
RP_TREE="$RP_DIR/tree"
git -C "$RP_ROOT" add -A || exit 1
git -C "$RP_ROOT" diff --binary --cached "$RP_BASE" > "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" || exit 1
git -C "$RP_ROOT" worktree add --detach "$RP_TREE" "$RP_BASE" || exit 1
if [ -s "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" ]; then git -C "$RP_TREE" apply --index "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" || exit 1; fi
git -C "$RP_TREE" -c user.name=gauntlet -c user.email=gauntlet@local commit -q --allow-empty -m "wave integrated snapshot" || exit 1
printf 'repair-base: %s %s\n' "$RP_TREE" "$(git -C "$RP_TREE" rev-parse HEAD)"
```
This prints `repair-base: <RP_TREE> <sha>`.

**2. Dispatch the funded implementer**

This repeats the escalated payload with the same anchors. It has no `context: "fresh"` and no prior-patch path.
```ts
subagent({ async: false, cwd: "<RP_TREE>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "implementer", as: "impl_3", model: "<configured-impl-model>",
      outputSchema: IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA,
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-repair<k>-task3.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      task: "planPath: <absolute plan>; anchor: ### Task 3:; Spec: <absolute home spec>; Leg: <owning leg>; Rules: <task Rules> + <leg> Rules from home ## Legs, resolved in the owning checkout; SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"]; wording: <abs commit-message.md>; ticket: <held ticket or none>.\n## Previous review report (re-review trigger)\n<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review4.md\nRead the saved report yourself before repairing. pi-cohort saves your final report; do not write it yourself." }
  ], worktree: true,
     stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED", "NEEDS_CONTEXT", "DONE_WITH_CONCERNS"] } }]
})
```
Observed result: `DONE`, with a nonempty delta at `<Artifacts>/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-0-implementer.patch`.

**3. Integrate the delta and run the gate**
```bash
test -s '<Artifacts>/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-0-implementer.patch'
git -C /workspace/project apply --index '<Artifacts>/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-0-implementer.patch'
git -C /workspace/project worktree remove --force '<RP_TREE>'
git -C /workspace/project add -A
git -C /workspace/project diff --stat --cached '<tree-before>'
(cd /workspace/project && node --test frame.test.mjs) > '<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-gate-<i>.log' 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
```
Print after each step:
```text
wave <w> repair <k> task 3 DONE report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-repair<k>-task3.md delta <Artifacts>/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-0-implementer.patch applied yes
wave <w> gate <i> exit 0
```

**4. Record the tree-after value**

This is the fix-delta block with `{{CHECKOUT}}` set to `'/workspace/project'`:
```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
SCRATCH="$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir)/gauntlet/tmp" || exit 1
mkdir -p "$SCRATCH" || exit 1
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp "$SCRATCH/fix-delta-index.XXXXXX") || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

**5. Dispatch wave re-review 5**
```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "wave-reviewer", output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review5.md",
      outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: WAVE_VERDICT_SCHEMA,
      task: "planPath: <absolute plan>; anchor: ### Task 3:; Spec: <absolute home spec>; Leg: <owning leg>; Rules: <combined task/leg Rules resolved in owning checkout>; BASE_SHA: <WAVE_BASE_SHA>; HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE; SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"]\n## Previous review report (re-review trigger)\n<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review4.md\n## Fix delta\ntree-before: <tree-before>\ntree-after: <tree-after>\nRun git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <tree-before> <tree-after> yourself. Append the TRAJECTORY line as the true final line." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/verdict", in: ["FIX_FIRST", "REJECT"] } }]
})
```
Observed result: `FIX_FIRST`, with `TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)`. Print:
```text
wave <w> review 5 verdict FIX_FIRST report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review5.md tree <tree-after>
```
The stop note needs the finding, so I read the report once: `read({ path: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review5.md", limit: 300 })`.
- It shows the same unresolved finding: `src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard`.
- The finding is not disproved, so it stands.

**6. Apply the transition**
- The funded round failed with an attributed `FIX_FIRST`, so it spends its one round: 1 of 1 spent, none left.
- The stop note comes next.
- Task 3 stays `in_progress` and the phase stays `implement`.
- No commit is made and no further dispatch is sent.

```
gauntlet: question
Stopped on task 3 (Validate frame); escalated round on <configured-impl-model> did not resolve it.

Problem: frame validation still lacks a length guard, and the funded fix rounds are used up, so the defect remains open.
budget: 1 of 1 spent
  src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard

Fix options:
  a) add an explicit length check at the start of frame validation that rejects a frame shorter than its declared length before any field is read, plus a test for a truncated frame
  b) amend spec section on frame validation / plan task 3 to state the exact length rule and add a test row for it, then re-run task 3
  c) raise the amend grant to fund one more fix round on the current approach

Pick one, or give another fix.
Recommendation: b - repeated passing fixes that keep missing the guard suggest the length rule is not pinned down in the task, so stating it gives the next round a concrete target.
```
The turn ends here.

# Independent snapshot: escalated dispatch returned `error: worker unavailable`

The escalated round counts as failed because its dispatch errored. That spends it. The task's funding ledger still has one round left (N = 1, 0 spent), so the funded round is next.

There is no rebuild, no new snapshot and no removal of the tree:
- The registered `RP_TREE` is reused.
- No writes occurred and the integrated tree has not changed.

Print:
```text
funded round 1 of 1 for task 3
```
Then dispatch the identical escalated payload into the registered repair tree. Only neutral facts are appended.
```ts
subagent({ async: false, cwd: "<registered RP_TREE>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "implementer", as: "impl_3", model: "<configured-impl-model>",
      outputSchema: IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA,
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-repair<k>-task3.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      task: "<retained escalated payload verbatim: planPath; anchor: ### Task 3:; Spec; Leg; Rules; SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"]; wording; ticket; ## Previous review report (re-review trigger) <prior report path>>\n## Diagnosis context\nThe previous dispatch of this payload returned a dispatch error before any worker result; no structured output was produced and no files were written. Siblings: none (singleton wave)." }
  ], worktree: true,
     stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED", "NEEDS_CONTEXT", "DONE_WITH_CONCERNS"] } }]
})
```
This round's result was not supplied, so I stop here. Task 3 stays `in_progress`.
